premises.text: Family/friends bill support via cash and check has a last-mile problem: money may not reach the biller and co-payers lack visibility
premises.evidence_span: Problem is last mile. Once I give them that money, it may not end up at its intended destination

premises.text: PayTap lets people collaborate on a bill with contributions going directly to the biller without requiring accounts
premises.evidence_span: We allow people to collaborate and contribute towards a bill with the money going directly to the biller

premises.text: Payers keep payment methods private, funds are FDIC-insured, and participants get alerts and contribution visibility
premises.evidence_span: no one gets to see my financial information, not her roommates, not my daughter

premises.text: Shared bill views support due dates, outstanding amounts, recurring payments, and invite-only visibility for helpers
premises.evidence_span: we can all see the bills. We can see the due dates. We can see the amount that's outstanding

premises.text: Merchant integrations (e.g. Amazon) let groups split purchases with money released when everyone has paid
premises.evidence_span: you can add an item from Amazon directly into Paytap

premises.text: Distribution via web/Facebook/mobile apps and by letting billers and merchants offer PayTap to their users
premises.evidence_span: we're allowing billers and online merchants to offer Paytap to their users so that they can get payments made

value.text: Elegant organization for shared payments that removes stress, steps, and hassle versus person-to-person money moves
value.evidence_span: We take out the stress, the steps, and all the hassle involved in making payments

causal_links.evidence_span: none allow you to collaborate together and contribute where the money goes directly to the biller
My funds are insured by the FDIC, and it goes directly to the biller
when everyone has paid their amounts, the money goes off to Amazon

notes: Cash/check last-mile and visibility pains folded as one problem (§4.1.6). No-signup share, multi-method pay, privacy, alerts, recurring, and invite visibility folded as collaboration product cascade (§4.1.7). Amazon merchant split kept as distinct commerce module. Biller/merchant offer path as GTM. Market size framing not a premise. Four domains.
